liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Lazy Lightnin'** (1 review): Explosive performance with pounding drums, leading into Supplication [15]
- **One More Saturday Night** (1 review): Listener considers this one of the best versions they have heard [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-12-31.141799.sbd.gurman.bershaw.sirmick.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 181 min [1]. Said about its sound: Described as a sort of sbd/ambient blend mix to mono [1]
- **gd1977-12-31.151333.sbd.bear.gems.V3.flac2496**: soundboard; 20 songs; 175 min [4]
- **gd1977-12-31.sbd.purvis.tetzeli.fix-286.35291.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 161 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [8]. Said about its sound: Sounds like a cross between a '77 and a '78 recording [17]
- **gd1977-12-31.sbd.heath.20596.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 161 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [9]. Said about its sound: First minute sounds identical to another upload, suggesting same lineage [14]

## Around the show

- Dazzlingly luminous, fog-free full moon night; fourth show in five days [16]
- New Riders Of The Purple Sage opened the concert [4]
- New Riders Of The Purple Sage opened the concert [6]
- Considered the off-show of the run, following one of the best shows ever [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-12-31.141799.sbd.gurman.bershaw.sirmick.flac1644**: taped by Bob Gurman and Alan Berdhaw; transferred by SIRMick; source: Source: SBD > Umatic videotape masters (noted as "remote") - From Bob Gurman; [1]. Also: Masters transferred direct to untracked CDs in 2002; labelled as Remote [1]
- **gd1977-12-31.151333.sbd.bear.gems.V3.flac2496**: taped by Bear; transferred by Transferred and Mastered by Jim Blackwood Speed Correction by Jason Chastain Patched where needed (mostly between song tunings) using shnid=141799 + 20596; source: Bear's Master Reel > Cassette (Music Never Stopped through Truckin') + Bear's Master Cassette (Wharf Rat through Casey Jones). [4]. Also: Version three fixed reversed tape channel and flipped mix for stage position [4]
- **gd1977-12-31.sbd.purvis.tetzeli.fix-286.35291.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Brian Purvis and Bill Tetzeli; source: SBD > Master Reel > DAT > CDR [8]
- **gd1977-12-31.sbd.heath.20596.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Brian Heath; source: SBD > Master Reel [9]
